scope-refinement: Windows has three supported guest ABIs here (X86, X64, Arm64). The four native execution views are ARM64, x64, x86 and x86 large-address-aware. The initial acceptance wording calling them four ABIs was imprecise.
observations: OpenProcess access0 returns Win32 error5 on the observed ARM64 host; access0x10,0x400,0x1000 self handles open. This is preserved, and a duplicate-own-handle control can measure an actual zero-access handle without changing token rights.
Zero length bypasses handle checks and publishes count0 when count pointer is valid.

A crossing source gives PARTIAL_COPY/count0 with no destination change; a crossing destination reports count4 despite no observed copied bytes. Do not equate reported count with a successful prefix copy.
